theorems.name: Submission.constancy_testFormOn_eq_finset_sum_subordinate
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (ι : Type) (V : ι → Set (Eucl P)), (∀ i, IsOpen (V i)) → ∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) n) ⊆ ⋃ i, V i → ∃ (s : Finset ι) (η : ι → TestFormOn U n), (∀ i ∈ s, tsupport (η i : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) n) ⊆ V i) ∧ ω = ∑ i ∈ s, η i
